extras.editor.intro: Things a traveller can add to a booking, such as an excursion, an upgrade or a dinner. Set one price or a price per age band, or let a rate card set the price. Travellers choose them on their own page; each choice is invoiced and paid there.
extras.editor.bandPricesHint: Leave a band empty to use the price above.
extras.editor.rateCardHint: Its selling price is used when the price above is 0.

extras.dep.alreadyCustomised: This extra is already changed for this departure.
extras.dep.overridesDescription: An extra with the same name and day as the tour's replaces it here; switch it off to hide it. New extras are added to this departure only.
extras.dep.chosenDescription: Staff can change a choice at any time, also after the cut-off. The extras invoice follows.
extras.dep.noPassengers: No travellers on this departure yet.
extras.dep.choicesDescription: Set how many of each extra this traveller has. Staff are not held to the cut-off.

extras.link.hint: Anyone with this address can open this page, so send it only to the party.
